description: Find subgraphs whose crawled manifest indexes a given contract on a given chain. Official subgraph-MCP name, better ranking: reliability_score then real query_volume_30d, not query fees and not the official 0-count oracle. contract_addresses come from subgraph.yaml dataSources/templates at crawl time — coverage is high for EVM subgraphs, empty for most substreams-powered ones. Does not query the gateway. Default 3 results, matching official.

chain.description: Official subgraph-MCP uses graph-node ids here (`mainnet`, not `ethereum`). We accept both; aliases resolve (ethereum→mainnet, arbitrum→arbitrum-one, polygon→matic).

name: get_top_subgraph_deployments
